4. Review selected changes
No changes selected.
Removed · Added · Yellow highlights the finding you’re viewing. Invisible edits use labeled markers.
Selected changes
Word originals download unchanged. Revised Word content exports as plain text; formatting is not preserved. Only selected character fixes or editorial suggestions change the exported copy.


Documents stay in page memory. Selecting Writing patterns & watermark tests sends text to your configured service when you review. Your writing guide stays in the browser. Reload clears document content; saving the service connection for this tab is optional.
